ideas.idea: Give each product its own page and add to sitemap
ideas.why: The shop page is a single listing of several parts, so separate URLs would give each item something to be found and quoted by.

ideas.idea: Add offers with price and availability to Product JSON-LD
ideas.why: This is the known missing-offers problem on the Product JSON-LD.

ideas.idea: Mark up a real product page or use ItemList instead of a single Product on the listing page
ideas.why: The /shop page lists several parts but describes only one 'Bilge pump' as a Product, so the markup doesn't match the page.

ideas.idea: Back up the delivery claim on a visible delivery page, since the free-delivery text is in data-nosnippet
ideas.why: The next-day shipping claim has no supporting details, and the only delivery text sits in the layout inside data-nosnippet, so a visible page with the terms would help.

ideas.idea: Add a viewport meta tag to app.html
ideas.why: It is accurate because app.html has no viewport tag, but it applies to almost any site and has little effect on being found.

ideas.idea: Add Organization and WebSite JSON-LD in the layout
ideas.why: No machine-readable statement of who Quay is exists, and the layout is a single place to add it.

ideas.idea: Improve page titles, e.g. 'Boat parts shop | Quay'
ideas.why: The current titles 'Shop all parts' and 'Quay: boat parts' are already descriptive, so rewording them has little effect.
It is accurate because the layout has no <main>, but it is a standard accessibility tweak with little effect on discovery.
It applies to nearly any sitemap and has a small effect on a two-URL site.

ideas.idea: Link home and shop pages to each other beyond the nav
ideas.why: The nav already links both pages on every route, so extra links add little.

ideas.idea: Generate the sitemap from routes once there are more pages
ideas.why: This is general advice with no effect on a two-page site today.

ideas.idea: Fix the contradictory bot rules in robots.txt
ideas.why: This is the known Googlebot block, already covered in the known problems.

ideas.idea: Make pages render on the server (remove ssr=false or prerender)
ideas.why: This is the known ssr=false problem.

ideas.idea: Set html lang and fill the shop meta description
ideas.why: Both are known problems already graded.
